about_the_game:
A dark tarot-judgment roguelite set in Dante’s Hell. Every choice reshapes the afterlife — will you redeem the lost souls, or condemn them forever?

Tarot-roguelite Gameplay

Tarot
At the heart of Beatrix lies a tarot-based card system inspired by the Major Arcana, where every card is both a weapon and an omen. The way you place and orient them determines not only the outcome of each duel, but also which fragments of a soul’s memory are revealed. These clues guide you toward the final judgment: Hell, Purgatory, or Paradise.

Judgment
Every run is a unique trial. You’ll confront a soul through three escalating battles, descending through Dante’s Circles of Hell and facing Guardians who slowly succumb to the very sins they once kept in check.

Your verdict doesn’t just decide a soul’s fate — it ripples outward, reshaping the balance of the afterlife itself.

Relationship-based Deckbuilder
Your deck is more than just tarot cards—it’s built on relationships. Forge bonds with the beings you encounter in each circle to gain, upgrade, and rank up cards, shaping your strategy with every choice you make.

Beatrix
In Beatrix, a tarot-based roguelite inspired by Dante’s Divine Comedy, you play as Beatrix, summoned by God to restore order to a corrupted afterlife. Souls, lost and trapped in circles where they don’t belong, await your judgment.

Only your choices can bring back balance… or plunge the world into chaos.

High Replayability
Collect new tarot cards, each with unique artwork and abilities, and build your deck to face and judge lost souls. Countless combinations make every run different and deeply strategic, keeping the experience fresh and engaging.

Key Features

  • Roguelite deckbuilder with tactical 3×3 grid battles, inspired by Triple Triad.

  • Moral judgment system: weigh every soul across three axes — Harm (The Blade), Intent (The Flame), and Remorse (The Veil).

  • Narrative exploration: between trials, encounter events and NPCs, uncover clues and contradictions, and expand your deck.

  • Corrupted Guardians: once-untouchable wardens of sin now decay under its influence, reshaping both story and gameplay.

  • Collectible Tarot decks: the 22 Major Arcana reimagined in striking artistic styles, each with unique symbolism and abilities.

  • Evolving world balance: your choices across runs reshape the afterlife, altering its destiny and unlocking multiple endings.

Coming soon in Italian, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Spanish.

AI Generated Content Disclosure - We want to assure our players that any AI-generated material used during development was strictly for reference purposes only. Every element you experience in the game was created by human artists, writers, and developers. At no point has AI replaced human work in any of the game’s content.

During development, we used AI tools solely to generate reference materials and support brainstorming sessions for our art, music, and design teams. This helped us prototype ideas faster and improve our internal creative workflow — never to produce final assets or in-game content.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mature themes and symbolic depictions that may be disturbing to some players. It includes references to the seven deadly sins, damnation, and corruption, along with stylized and psychological violence. There are no explicit sexual acts, but themes of lust, faith, and moral judgment are present throughout. The overall tone is dark and may not be suitable for all audiences.
